verdict.rationale: Omnara documents that users can attach images and documents to an agent conversation, so a screenshot or mockup can be supplied as task input. Nothing shows the agent interpreting markup or turning visual references into correct UI changes. Missing for 10: evidence that attached images reach a vision-capable model and guide implementation, annotation/markup support, task-level (vs. conversation) attachment docs, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach a marked-up screenshot or mockup to a task so the agent implements the correct visual change

citations.quote: You can also attach images and documents to a conversation.
